title: Learning Functional Subspaces for Neural Network Compression
abstract: Modern transformers pair impressive capabilities with substantial memory and compute demands. Low-rank weight factorization reduces both while keeping the matrices dense, and thus efficient on standard hardware. Existing methods, however, choose the subspace to remove from each weight matrix with local closed-form criteria: activation energy, layer-wise reconstruction error, or a quadratic approximation of the loss. These criteria ignore how errors propagate through the network, so at high compression the errors compound with depth and performance collapses. We introduce Learnable Subspace Projections (LSP), which instead learns the subspaces to discard end-to-end. Each linear layer, or tied group of layers that read the same activations, is assigned an orthogonal projector. All projectors are optimized jointly against a global objective--the KL divergence to the dense model's output distribution or the model's original training loss--while the pretrained weights remain frozen. Projectors are initialized from a whitened SVD truncation, and ranks are allocated by the output KL each projector induces per parameter saved. After training, the projectors merge into standard low-rank factors, with each tied group sharing one factor. In attention, this also lets the model cache one narrow latent in place of full keys and values. Across LLMs (OPT-125M/1.3B, Qwen3-4B, Llama-2-7B) and ViT-B/16, LSP outperforms baselines, and its advantage widens as compression increases. At -70% compression, LSP brings Llama-2-7B to 10.9 WikiText-2 perplexity and 42.2% mean zero-shot accuracy, versus 13.3 and 36.0% for the strongest baseline. The factorized model decodes up to 1.6x faster than the dense model at small batch sizes, and aching the shared latent shrinks the combined memory of weights and KV cache by 13.5x at a 128k-token context, versus at most 6.5x for untied baseline factorizations.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a hypothetical course called Efficient Transformer Architectures, today’s lecture is on Learnable Subspace Projections for Large Language Model Compression. As models grow, researchers are looking for ways to reduce their memory and compute demands. Work such as Swift-S-V-D studies low-rank compression, while x K-V addresses a related memory bottleneck in attention caches. This paper asks whether compression should follow a layer’s statistics or the model’s output. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在一门假设叫高效Transformer架构的课上，今天讲的是面向大语言模型压缩的可学习子空间投影。随着模型越来越大，研究者一直在想办法降低它们的内存和计算需求。像Swift-S-V-D这样的工作研究的是低秩压缩，而x K-V处理的则是注意力缓存里一个相关的内存瓶颈。这篇论文问的是，压缩到底应该遵循某一层的统计特性，还是应该遵循模型的输出。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi, Professor. Why might a direction that looks unimportant in one layer matter to the whole model?
segments.zh: 嗨，教授。为什么一个在某层看起来不重要的方向会对整个模型有影响呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Because a layer’s local statistics do not necessarily reveal how its changes affect later computations. Imagine removing a quiet instrument from an orchestra: it may be faint on its own, but still matter to the final sound. The authors’ motivation is that energy or reconstruction error alone can miss a direction’s downstream importance. Their method, L-S-P, learns which directions to remove by comparing the compressed model’s output with the dense model’s output.
segments.zh: 因为一层的局部统计量不一定能反映出它的变化会如何影响后续计算。想象一下，从交响乐团里拿掉一件声音很轻的乐器：它单独听可能很微弱，但对最终的音响效果仍然有影响。作者的动机是，单看能量或重建误差，可能会漏掉某个方向在下游的重要性。他们的方法 L-S-P 通过比较压缩模型的输出和稠密模型的输出，来学习该去掉哪些方向。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So L-S-P changes which directions are removed, rather than simply choosing a smaller rank?
segments.zh: 所以L-S-P改变的是移除哪些方向，而不是简单地选一个更小的秩？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is the key distinction. A projector removes selected input directions from a linear layer, limiting the layer’s rank. Some layers read the same activations, so they can share a projector; for example, query, key, and value projections can be tied. Other layers are projected on their smaller side. This gives the method a way to coordinate compatible layers while still choosing different compression decisions across the network.
segments.zh: 这就是关键区别。投影器会从线性层中移除选定的输入方向，从而限制该层的秩。有些层读取的是相同的激活值，所以它们可以共享一个投影器；比如查询、键和值的投影就可以绑定在一起。其他层则是在较小的一侧进行投影。这样一来，这个方法就能协调兼容的层，同时还能在整个网络中做出不同的压缩决策。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does it decide which directions to test and how much rank to keep?
segments.zh: 它如何决定要测试哪些方向，以及保留多少秩？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It begins with calibration activations and uses a whitened S-V-D truncation to initialize candidate projectors. Then it measures the output K-L cost of removing directions from one unit at a time, while the rest of the network remains dense. Those measurements guide a greedy rank allocation, trading output cost against parameters saved. It is a practical surrogate, not a globally optimal allocation: interactions between units are not fully captured by these isolated measurements.
segments.zh: 它从校准激活开始，用白化后的SVD截断来初始化候选投影器。然后逐个单元测量移除方向时的输出KL代价，同时网络其余部分保持稠密。这些测量结果指导一种贪心的秩分配，在输出代价和节省的参数之间做权衡。这是一个实用的替代方案，而不是全局最优的分配：这些孤立测量无法完全捕捉单元之间的相互作用。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does training then change the original model weights as well as the projectors?
segments.zh: 那训练之后，除了投影器，原始模型的权重也会改变吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In the default setup, the pretrained weights stay frozen while the projectors are trained jointly to match the dense model’s output distribution. The paper also considers using the original task loss, but output distillation is the central approach. Once training is complete, each projection can be merged into ordinary low-rank factors. With a shared input factor, tied key and value layers can also use one narrow latent representation.
segments.zh: 在默认设置下，预训练权重保持冻结，而投影器则联合训练，以匹配稠密模型的输出分布。论文也考虑了使用原始任务损失，但输出蒸馏才是核心方法。训练完成后，每个投影都可以合并为普通的低秩因子。在共享输入因子的情况下，绑定的键层和值层也可以使用同一个窄的潜在表示。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The cleanest test of whether learning matters is the No L-S-P control. It shares L-S-P’s initialization, allocated ranks, and ties, but leaves the projectors untrained. On Llama two seven B at 70% compression, WikiText-2 test perplexity is 10.9 for trained L-S-P and 222.8 for No L-S-P; lower perplexity means better next-token prediction. S-V-D L-L-M, the strongest baseline in that setting, scores 13.3.
segments.zh: 检验学习是否真正起作用，最干净的做法就是设置一个No L-S-P对照组。它和L-S-P共享初始化、分配的秩和绑定关系，但不训练投影器。在Llama 2 7B、70%压缩率下，WikiText-2测试困惑度：训练过的L-S-P是10.9，No L-S-P是222.8；困惑度越低，说明下一个token预测得越准。同一设定下最强的基线SVD-LLM得分是13.3。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Is that perplexity result directly comparable to the zero-shot accuracy result?
segments.zh: 那个困惑度结果能直接和零样本准确率结果比较吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: They answer different questions under different protocols. For perplexity, calibration uses 1,024 sequences of 2,048 tokens from the WikiText-2 training split. Separately, the Alpaca-calibrated zero-shot evaluation reports a 42.2% mean plain accuracy for L-S-P, versus 36% for S-V-D L-L-M. That mean is the arithmetic average across ARC-easy, PIQA, OpenBookQA, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, and MathQA, not a measure of every capability.
segments.zh: 它们回答的是不同协议下的不同问题。困惑度方面，校准用的是WikiText-2训练集里1024条长度为2048个token的序列。另外，用Alpaca校准的零样本评测显示，L-S-P的平均朴素准确率是42.2%，而S-V-D L-L-M是36%。这个平均值是ARC-easy、PIQA、OpenBookQA、WinoGrande、HellaSwag和MathQA这几个基准上的算术平均，并不代表模型在所有能力上的表现。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: There are also deployment results, but it is important to keep throughput and memory capacity distinct. At 70% compression, batch size 1, and a 512-token context, measured decoding reaches 221 tokens per second for L-S-P versus 141 for the dense model. A separate latent-cache calculation gives 38.9 gibibytes for weights plus cache at 128,000 cached tokens and batch size 8, versus 524.6 gibibytes dense. That capacity result requires attention software that stores the shared narrow latent.
segments.zh: 也有部署结果，但要把吞吐量和内存容量区分开来看。在70%压缩率、批大小为1、上下文长度为512个token的情况下，实测解码速度L-S-P达到每秒221个token，而稠密模型是141个。另一项针对潜在缓存的测算显示，在缓存128,000个token、批大小为8时，权重加缓存的占用是38.9吉比字节，而稠密模型是524.6吉比字节。这个容量结果需要注意力软件能够存储共享的窄潜在表示。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Could the latent cache itself explain the measured decoding speedup?
segments.zh: 潜在缓存本身能解释测得的解码加速吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Not from these results. The speed measurement uses a short context and a full-width K-V cache; the latent-cache figure concerns memory capacity under a different setup. Compression also has costs: measuring K-L and training projectors take resources. At a fixed compression ratio, factorized methods can have similar operation counts, so actual speed depends on the shape and number of matrix multiplies and the inference conditions, not just the parameter reduction.
segments.zh: 从这些结果里看不出来。速度测量用的是短上下文和全宽K-V缓存；而潜在缓存的数字说的是另一种设置下的内存容量。压缩也有代价：测量K-L和训练投影器都要消耗资源。在固定压缩比下，因子化方法的运算次数可能差不多，所以实际速度取决于矩阵乘法的形状和数量以及推理条件，而不只是参数量的减少。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Compared with S-V-D L-L-M, L-S-P replaces a closed-form, layer-wise reconstruction choice with projectors trained against a network-level output objective, while freezing the pretrained weights. Dobi-S-V-D is another useful contrast: it optimizes truncation positions, but its basis is still closed-form. This distinction is not simply whether a method uses a loss; it is whether the removed subspaces themselves are learned end to end against the model’s output.
segments.zh: 与S-V-D L-L-M相比，L-S-P用针对网络级输出目标训练出的投影器，替换了闭式的逐层重建选择，同时冻结预训练权重。Dobi-S-V-D是另一个有用的对照：它优化截断位置，但其基底仍是闭式的。这一区别并不只是方法是否使用损失函数，而在于被移除的子空间本身是否针对模型输出进行端到端学习。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does the evidence show that L-S-P preserves behavior broadly across tasks and users?
segments.zh: 这些证据是否表明L-S-P能在各类任务和用户中广泛保持行为不变？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. The reported evidence supports an advantage in the specified WikiText-2 and six-benchmark conditions, not universal behavior preservation. The authors also caution that aggregate results can hide uneven losses on underrepresented populations, domains, or rare behaviors. The broader implication is a shift in what compression can optimize: instead of treating a layer’s spectrum as the final guide, researchers can use model outputs to inform which directions are expendable, while still accounting for calibration and allocation limits.
segments.zh: 不能。报告中的证据只支持在特定的WikiText-2和六个基准条件下具有优势，并不支持普遍的行为保持。作者也提醒，聚合结果可能掩盖在代表性不足的人群、领域或稀有行为上的不均衡损失。更广泛的含义是压缩可以优化的方向发生了转变：不再把某一层的频谱当作最终指导，研究者可以利用模型输出来判断哪些方向是可以舍弃的，同时仍需考虑校准和分配的限制。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The takeaway is that compression is a choice of directions, not merely a choice of rank. L-S-P shows why learning removals against network output can be a more informative guide than relying on a layer’s spectrum alone, though its evidence remains bounded by its calibration data and approximate rank allocator. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 结论是，压缩其实是在选择方向，而不只是在选择秩。L-S-P 说明了为什么根据网络输出来学习该移除哪些方向，比只依赖某一层的频谱更有信息量，不过它的证据仍然受限于校准数据和近似的秩分配器。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
